features.featureTitle: In QuizScreen.tsx, add a 'Skip' button alongside the existing 'Next' button. When the user clicks 'Skip', the current question is recorded as skipped (no answer selected) and the quiz advances to the next question. Skipped questions must be tracked in the answers array passed to onComplete so the ResultsScreen can display a skipped count. The Skip button must be disabled or hidden on the last question (where the user must submit or skip to end the quiz). Apply the existing parchment/teal/gold theme styling to the Skip button.

In QuizScreen.tsx, add a visible countdown timer displayed prominently at the top of the quiz card (e.g., near the question counter). The timer should count down from a fixed duration of 60 seconds per question. When the timer reaches zero, the current question is automatically skipped and the quiz advances to the next question. The timer must reset to 60 seconds each time a new question is shown. Display the remaining time in MM:SS format (e.g., '01:00'). Style the timer with the existing teal/gold theme; turn the timer text red when 10 or fewer seconds remain to warn the user.
